proof_body:
by
  intro m n x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ p q hm hn
  have hs : m + n ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [eq_div_iff hs, eq_div_iff hs]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (m n x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ p q : ℝ), 0 < m → 0 < n → ((n * (p - x₁) = m * (x₂ - p) ∧ n * (q - y₁) = m * (y₂ - q)) ↔ (p = (n * x₁ + m * x₂) / (m + n) ∧ q = (n * y₁ + m * y₂) / (m + n)))
